blocks.text: I finally stood beneath the Eiffel Tower today, and no photo had prepared me for how enormous it really is up close. Gustave Eiffel's iron lattice seems to disappear into the clouds, and the sound of the wind through the girders is something I didn't expect.
By the time I came back after sunset, the whole structure was lit gold and sparkling on the hour, and the Champ de Mars below was full of people sitting on picnic blankets just watching it shine.
